claim_one_line: THE DESIGN AUDIT: THREE PLACES THE PROMPTS COULD ONLY REMOVE CANDIDATES, AND NO EVIDENCE OF INTENTIONAL BIAS. The owner posed a deliberately ADVERSARIAL PREMISE -- assume the negatives were manufactured and prove otherwise -- as a stress-test to force maximum scrutiny of the bottlenecks and of any wrong approach. Recorded as METHOD, not as a belief about the seats; the owner clarified the intent on 2026-08-19 and this arc carries the clarification rather than the original shorthand. cc supplied the B1074/B1076 orchestration scripts verbatim and asked that a design flaw producing 'a positive that ours structurally could not' outrank any recomputation. FINDING 1 (headline, NOT named by cc): the B1016 guard is STRICTER than the reopening condition it quotes verbatim. The condition requires a FRAME-INVARIANT RESIDUE and disqualifies ONE named quantity (the coupling's Re h); the prompt disqualifies AN ENTIRE CLASS ('or any coupling-channel quantity') and adds a positive requirement ('must be PAIR-CHANNEL-NATIVE'). A residue that is genuinely frame-invariant but built from both channels would SATISFY the banked condition and be STRUCTURALLY EXCLUDED by the prompt before evaluation. Defensible in spirit, but a strengthening, undisclosed in the arc, and able only to remove candidates. It does NOT show such a residue exists -- it shows the design could not have told us either way. FINDING 2: the MB12 bite-witness is per-candidate and redundant with the separate non-triviality test; (3) object-dependence is the correct vacuity test, while the companion-variant demand additionally requires something NEAR the candidate to vary, so a real invariant whose natural companions are also invariant fails a test it need not face; a global instrument bite-witness would establish non-vacuity without letting a candidate's neighbourhood veto it. FINDING 3: the grade enum ['THEOREM-EXACT','COMPUTED-EXACT','COMPUTED-FLOAT-ORIENTATION','NOT-COMPUTABLE-HERE'] has NO rung for established-but-partial, so a real but partly-nailed candidate can only be filed NOT-COMPUTABLE-HERE, which reads downstream as a negative -- asymmetric, since a partial NEGATIVE is fully expressible while a partial POSITIVE is not. WHAT I DID NOT FIND: no evidence of intentional bias anywhere; every guard traces to a banked discipline applied consistently; Gate 5's classes-only phrasing is SOUND (cc's no-by-construction holds, since a value-level search would be value-matching, which B724's look-elsewhere theorem already shows is worthless); the adversarial Verify phases are genuinely adversarial and better designed than most work I audit; and B1076's 'Either answer is the result -- computed, not hoped' is the opposite of a biased instruction. THE SHAPE: each finding is a guard that can only remove candidates, never add them, with the strengthening beyond the banked condition undisclosed in the arc. None shows the negatives are wrong; all three show the design could not have produced the positive if one existed. SCOPE: the orchestration scripts as supplied plus B1075's sealed prereg; NOT a re-audit of the arithmetic, which ran separately and came back clean. Gate 5 untouched.
